info.title: Agent Core Identity API
info.description: API documentation for Agent Core Identity service - manages authentication, authorization, and secret management for agent-based systems

tags.name: Delegated API Key Provider
tags.description: APIs for managing delegated API key providers - user-provided API keys for external services

tags.name: API Key Provider
tags.description: APIs for managing API key providers - static API keys for external service authentication

tags.name: Agent Identity
tags.description: APIs for managing agent identities - digital identities for agents to access external services

tags.name: OAuth2 Provider
tags.description: APIs for managing OAuth2 providers and retrieving OAuth2 tokens (M2M and 3-Legged OAuth)

get.description: Retrieves a specific agent identity by name.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Name of the agent identity to retrieve

put.description: Updates an existing agent identity. Only description and allowed return URLs can be modified.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Name of the agent identity to update

delete.description: Soft deletes an agent identity. The identity will be marked as deleted but not physically removed.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Name of the agent identity to delete

get.description: Retrieves a paginated list of all agent identities owned by the authenticated user.

post.description: Creates a new agent identity for the authenticated user. Agent identities are used to represent digital identities for agents accessing external services.

409.description: Agent identity with this name already exists

oauth2.description: OAuth2 authentication for Agent Core Identity API
